title: Oh! Great is our God
lyrics_original: To hail the majesty of our King
So lift your voices loud as we sing
So let our songs be endless!
So we will make it known to our kids
And we will sing about the gracious gifts you give    || We will ||
His mercy covers all that Heʼs made
Showing His glory and His grace    || We will ||

bible_verses.telugu: మన దేవుని పట్టణమందు ఆయన పరిశుద్ధ పర్వతమందు యెహోవా గొప్పవాడును బహు కీర్తనీయుడునై యున్నాడు.
bible_verses.english: Great is the Lord, and most worthy of praise, in the city of our God, his holy mountain.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా మహాత్మ్యముగలవాడు ఆయన అధికస్తోత్రము నొందదగినవాడు ఆయన మహాత్మ్యము గ్రహింప శక్యము కానిది
bible_verses.english: Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; his greatness no one can fathom.

bible_verses.telugu: నీ మహా దయాళుత్వమును గూర్చిన కీర్తిని వారు ప్రకటించెదరు నీ నీతినిగూర్చి  వారు గానము చేసెదరు
bible_verses.english: They celebrate your abundant goodness and joyfully sing of your righteousness.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, You are truly great and worthy of all our praise. Forgive me for the times I bring You quiet, hesitant worship when Your majesty demands our fullest joy. Fill my heart with awe today as I reflect on Your goodness and unfailing love. May my life and my voice pour forth Your fame, honoring You in everything I do. Amen.

Fill my heart with awe today as I reflect on Your goodness and unfailing love. May my life and my voice pour forth Your fame, honoring You in everything I do. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: When we contemplate the magnitude of God’s majesty, simple words often feel inadequate. Yet, as Psalm 145 reminds us, His immense greatness invites a joyful, unreserved overflow of praise from our hearts. Whether through quiet gratitude or resounding song, every expression of worship honors the King who poured out His love for us. Today, let yourself be drawn into the beauty of His holiness and give Him the heartfelt glory He truly deserves.
